items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: But I didn't know Moody at that particular time.

ctx.x: Was there anyone else who came out of Savannah that stayed in music and made any kind of a name?

Later years but I didn't know him them. James Moody came out of Savannah. But I didn't know Moody at that particular time. I guess there are other guys who I really don't know who were musicians in Savannah that came out. There were good musicians all through the South, Atlanta and Savannah. Higginbotham came from Atlanta, J. C. did. He was originally -- he was born down in Georgia (inaudible). Quite a few good guys came from down around in that district, but I didn't know any of them back, there then. You know,…
